other_conditions: Applicants must be permanent residents of Arunachal Pradesh.
All categories of farmers (marginal, small, medium, large) are eligible.
Up to 50 FPOs (societies or companies) in the state may apply.
FPO must be a registered body under the Societies Act, Cooperative Society Act, or Companies Act.
FPO must have an active bank account for at least six months.
A resolution of the FPO board/governing council is required to seek the revolving fund.
Revolving funds must be used only for production, growth, and marketing activities of the FPO.
benefits_summary: Each eligible FPO receives a revolving fund of ₹4 lakh and an additional financial assistance of ₹2.5 lakh for mobilisation, training, registration, and office setup.
